name: New Born — NBC newborn COB event: no Limited Liability record, request a COB update
description: Eleven guided steps, one per row of the NBC.1 document: identify the PX_NBC hard edit among all eight edits, verify the patient's state, check the event hierarchy, note the date of birth, verify the billed amount exceeds $10,000.00, check the Limited Liability record, open Request Claim Review from the Action menu, select Request COB Update, mark the review as related to a newborn and add comments, submit the request, and submit the claim without a decision.

steps.name: Identify the NBC hard edit
steps.description: Open the Event Resolution tab. The system lists every edit the claim hit; PX_NBC is the Hard Edit highlighted with an error indication, and it is the event you are here to resolve. NBC is a newborn coordination-of-benefits event: it prompts you to check whether the newborn may have other insurance, and whether the claim's Limited Liability (LL) record shows which plan is primary and which is secondary.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Event Resolution tab is clicked while this step is active. It is the tab the workspace opens on, so the click is a deliberate one.
steps.hint: On 'Event Resolution', the Active Edit section shows Edit Code PX_NBC with a Hard Edit badge, and All Edits lists it first.

steps.name: Verify the patient's state
steps.description: Open the Member Info tab and check the state associated with the patient, in the Patient section. These guidelines do not apply when the state is CONV; a claim from that state follows the alternate SOP steps instead. Here the state is NH, so you proceed.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Member Info tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: On 'Member Info', the Patient section shows State = NH.

steps.name: Check the event hierarchy
steps.description: Return to the Event Resolution tab and review the list of events to see whether any other event must be resolved before NBC, following the established event hierarchy. If other events are present, resolve those first in hierarchy order; if none are, proceed. Here PX_NBC is the only active event and no other priority event is present, so you proceed.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee returns to the Event Resolution tab from Member Info while this step is active.
steps.hint: Back on 'Event Resolution', read down the All Edits list. Only PX_NBC is marked active.

steps.name: Note the patient's Date of Birth
steps.description: Go back to the Member Info tab and note the patient's Date of Birth (DOB) in the Patient section. Here the DOB is 09/14/2026.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee returns to the Member Info tab from Event Resolution while this step is active.
steps.hint: On 'Member Info', the Patient section shows Date Of Birth (DOB) = 09/14/2026.
steps.checklistItem: Note the patient's Date of Birth

steps.name: Verify the billed amount exceeds $10,000
steps.description: Open the Claim Lines tab and review the billed amount on the claim. The NBC event fires when the billed amount is greater than $10,000.00. Here the claim is billed $12,762.00, which exceeds $10,000.00, so you proceed.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Lines tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: On 'Claim Lines', Line 1 shows Billed = $12,762.00. The claim summary bar shows the same total.

steps.name: Check whether the LL record is updated
steps.description: Open the Search tab and select the Limited Liability sub-tab to check whether a Limited Liability record has been updated for the newborn. If the LL record is updated, process the claim under the standard claim processing guidelines; if it is not, follow the routing guidelines and request a COB update. Here no Limited Liability record is found, so the records are not updated and you go on to route the claim.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Limited Liability sub-tab is selected while this step is active. The Search tab opens on Benefits, so Limited Liability is a deliberate selection.
steps.hint: On 'Search', select the 'Limited Liability' sub-tab. The results read that limited liability information is not found.
steps.checklistItem: Check whether the LL record is updated

steps.name: Open the Request Claim Review action
steps.description: Go to the claim summary at the top of the workspace, open the Action menu and select Request Claim Review. A dialog appears with the message "Please select the action to perform".
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when Request Claim Review is chosen from the Action menu while this step is active, which opens the dialog. Chosen earlier, the dialog stays closed.
steps.hint: The Action menu is on the claim summary bar. Choose 'Request Claim Review'.
steps.checklistItem: Open the Request Claim Review action

steps.name: Select Request COB Update
steps.description: In the "Please select the action to perform" dropdown, select Request COB Update. The dialog then expands to show the COB update options.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes only when claimReview.action is Request COB Update. Selecting any other option leaves the step open and reveals nothing.
steps.hint: Open the dropdown in the Request Claim Review dialog and choose 'Request COB Update'.

steps.name: Select Review Related to Newborn and add comments
steps.description: Tick the "Is this review related to a newborn" checkbox — the Review Related to Newborn option — and then enter the review details in the Comments box, for example "Please update LL records".
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when claimReview.relatedToNewborn is set to true. The comment is checked on the next step: the dialog's Submit is refused while Comments is empty.
steps.hint: Tick 'Is this review related to a newborn', then type the review details into Comments.
steps.checklistItem: Select Review Related to Newborn and add comments

steps.name: Submit the COB update request
steps.description: With the comments entered, click the Submit button in the dialog. A comment must be present in the Comments box for the submission to be accepted. The Limited Liability record is not updated, so the claim is routed for COB Update Review with the Review Related to Newborn option selected.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the dialog's Submit is pressed with Request COB Update selected, the newborn checkbox ticked and a non-blank comment entered. Otherwise the press is refused and the Submit status says what is missing.
steps.hint: Click 'Submit' at the bottom of the Request Claim Review dialog. If nothing happens, check that Comments is not empty.

steps.name: Submit without a decision
steps.description: Close the Request Claim Review dialog, then click Submit on the claim summary without selecting a decision. Do not choose Pay or Deny: the claim is being routed for COB Update Review with the Review Related to Newborn option selected, not adjudicated.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the claim is submitted with no decision selected. Submitting Pay, Deny or Pend does not complete it.
steps.hint: Leave the decision empty — do not pick Pay or Deny from the Action menu — and click Submit on the claim summary bar.
